note: M9 NC review F2: written without the blank, 'GOTOF:70' tokenizes as a jump label 'GOTOF:' and a word of no address. A label named like a jump cannot be a label, so its colon is the main prefix and the jump names the main block ':70', which it follows to ':160', as 'GOTOB:20' behind an IF follows ':20' to ':110'. Before, ':70' was renumbered and 'GOTOF:70' was neither rewritten nor reported.
